تلتحموا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِمُوا (taltaḥimū) /tal.ta.ħi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# تُلْتَحَمُوا (tultaḥamū) /tul.ta.ħa.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
